verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for an API-driven billing service, but nothing in the evidence pack documents restricted or least-privilege keys. The MCP server and CLI items show agents can call the Stripe API, but they say nothing about limiting a credential's permissions, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
